{{Expert needed|1=Mathematics|talk=Statement of the conjecture|date=May 2026}}

In [[deformation theory]], a branch of mathematics, '''Deligne's conjecture''' is about the [[operad]]ic structure on [[Hochschild homology|Hochschild cochain complex]]. Various proofs have been suggested by [[Dmitry Tamarkin]],{{efn|Some sources cite Tamarkin's proof as the first real proof.<ref>{{cite book |last1=Hess |first1=Kathryn |title=Deligne’s Hochschild Cohomology Conjecture |url= https://www.sas.rochester.edu/mth/sites/doug-ravenel/otherpapers/Hess-Deligne.pdf}}</ref>}}<ref>{{cite arXiv |last=Tamarkin |first=Dmitry E. |date=1998 |title=Another proof of M. Kontsevich formality theorem |eprint=math/9803025 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1= Hinich |first1= Vladimir |year= 2003 |title= Tamarkin's proof of Kontsevich formality theorem |url=https://www.degruyter.com/view/journals/form/15/4/article-p591.xml |journal= Forum Math. |volume= 15 |issue= 4 |pages= 591–614 |doi=10.1515/form.2003.032 |arxiv= math/0003052 |s2cid= 220814 }}</ref> [[Alexander A. Voronov]],<ref>{{cite conference |chapter-url=https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-94-015-1276-3_23 |chapter=Homotopy Gerstenhaber algebras |last1= Voronov |first1= Alexander A. |title=Conférence Moshé Flato 1999 |date= 2000 |publisher=Kluwer Acad. Publ. |book-title= Conférence Moshé Flato 1999, Vol. II (Dijon) |pages= 307–331 |location= Dordrecht |doi=10.1007/978-94-015-1276-3_23 |arxiv=math/9908040 |isbn=978-90-481-5551-4 }}</ref> [[James E. McClure]] and [[Jeffrey H. Smith]],<ref>{{cite conference |url=http://www.ams.org.ezp2.lib.umn.edu/books/conm/293/ |title=A solution of Deligne's Hochschild cohomology conjecture |last1= McClure |first1= James E. |last2= Smith | first2 = Jeffrey H. |date= 2002 |publisher= Amer. Math. Soc. |book-title= Recent progress in homotopy theory (Baltimore, MD, 2000) |pages= 153–193 |location= Providence, RI |arxiv=math/9910126 }}</ref> [[Maxim Kontsevich]] and [[Yan Soibelman]],<ref>{{cite conference |arxiv=math/0001151 |title=Deformations of algebras over operads and the Deligne conjecture |last1= Kontsevich |first1= Maxim |last2= Soibelman |first2= Yan |date= 2000 |publisher=Kluwer Acad. Publ. |book-title= Conférence Moshé Flato 1999, Vol. I (Dijon) |pages= 255–307 |location= Dordrecht }}</ref> and others, after an initial input of construction of [[Homotopical algebra|homotopy algebraic structures]] on the Hochschild complex.<ref>{{cite arXiv |last1=Getzler |first1=Ezra |last2=Jones |first2=J. D. S. |date=1994 |title=Operads, homotopy algebra and iterated integrals for double loop spaces |eprint=hep-th/9403055 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1= Voronov |first1= A. A. |last2= Gerstenhaber |first2= M. |year= 1995 |title=Higher operations on the Hochschild complex |url=https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007%2FBF01077036 |journal= Funct. Anal. Its Appl. |volume= 29 |pages=1–5 |doi=10.1007/BF01077036 |s2cid= 121740728 |url-access= subscription }}</ref> It is of importance in relation with [[string theory]].
